text:
maria: FYI I'm starting the observability rollout for eu-west-2 -> new-gpu-pool-7. Need a short bootstrap + validation checklist and an alerting template we can hand off to oncall.

devon: copying checklist from last region, but want to slim it down. key concerns: logs egress costs, Prom scrape coverage, and trace sampling on GPU jobs.

janet: +1 on sampling. set traces to 0.2 for batch jobs initially. real-time infer servers should stay at 1.0.

kai: networking note — we need the VPC peering to logging-collector-east to be in place or logs will dead-letter due to S3 bucket region mismatch. I ran `aws s3api get-bucket-location` earlier and saw mismatch.

maria: kai can you paste the peering CIDR rule? ops-bot: did the last peering create succeed?

kai: it's 10.20.0.0/16 -> 10.7.0.0/16. Ran `terraform plan` in infra/peering and it shows a pending apply. don't apply until logging collectors are ready.

sre-bot: ALERT: cluster-health check failed on new-gpu-pool-7 master: out-of-disk 3 nodes. (auto-check at 1773502100).

devon: that's expected — kube-system logging pods scheduled to nodes and filled /var/log. quick fix: `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets && ssh node && sudo du -sh /var/log/*` then rotate logs. I'll open a short ticket.

maria: add runbook step: rotate node logs and verify kubelet log retention 7d. Also ensure nodepool taints for batch-vs-realtime.

janet: Dashboard TODOs:
- Grafana: clone "infra/gpu-cluster-overview" and change datasource + region vars
- Panel: GPU utilization, pod restart rate, tail latency (p50/p95/p99), node disk usage
- Logs: Kibana view for inference errors with `error OR exception` over last 6h

maria: for alerts, I want low-noise rules. Start with these templates and we can tune after two days of traffic:
```yaml
- alert: HighGPUUtilization
  expr: avg_over_time(gpu_utilization{cluster="new-gpu-pool-7"}[5m]) > 0.9
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "GPU utilisation >90% for 10m in eu-west-2"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/obs-eu-west-2-gpu"

- alert: HighLogEgress
  expr: increase(s3_put_bytes_total{bucket="logs-redwood-eu"}[1h]) > 1073741824 # >1GB/h
  for: 30m
  labels:
    severity: ticket
  annotations:
    summary: "High log egress from new-gpu-pool-7"
    remediation: "Consider reducing log level or enabling client-side sampling for debug logs"
```

devon: nice. For HighLogEgress we should route to billing channel and ops-email for the first alert, then to pager only if sustained after 3 hours.

kai: also add network-health alert: BGP flap or peer latency >200ms for 5m. We saw cross-region replication issue last time.

maria: validation checklist (short):
1) Peering and route tables confirmed (kai)
2) Prometheus scrape targets >95% (devon)
3) Traces sampling applied and visible in traces UI (janet)
4) Dashboards cloned & vars set (janet)
5) Basic alerts created & alertmanager routes tested (maria)
6) Cost guard rails: S3 lifecycle rule + egress alert (devon)
7) Handoff doc + oncall ping (maria)

janet: to test alert routing: use `amtool` to fire a synthetic alert and verify pager/ops email. I can run that after alerts are deployed. example:
```
amtool alert add HighGPUUtilization  --labels cluster=new-gpu-pool-7,severity=page --annotations summary="test"
```

maria: owner assignments: kai -> network/peering, devon -> prometheus & alerts, janet -> dashboards & tracing, maria -> handoff + runbook.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window for new-gpu-pool-7 is 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC. Any disruptive changes should be avoided outside that window.

devon: note on cost: enabling debug logs for grpc increases S3 by ~2x. suggest default `info` for inference pods, `debug` only during investigations.

maria: final step before handoff: drop a short playground test (small batch job + 10 concurrent requests to realtime service) and confirm dashboards + alerts behave as expected. I'll schedule with oncall for 1773502600.

kai: I'll hold off on apply until you give green.

maria: thanks all — I'll update the runbook link once it's copied into docs. ping me in thread with any blockers. :raised_hands:
